sentences.en: Why did you sign that confession if it wasn't true?
sentences.zh: 如果你没说实话，为什么签了那份供认状？

sentences.en: Should I make a confession of my past to her?
sentences.zh: 我是否应该向她坦白我的过去？

sentences.en: Sami went to the authorities to make a confession.
sentences.zh: 萨米去有关部门自首了。

senses.zh: 承认；自首，供认声明，表白(指宗教信仰)(向神父的)忏悔，告解
